      "reason": "The surface finish symbol is present in the tolerance table area but no explicit Ra value is printed; only 'UNSP.RADII' and 'UNSP.CHF.' are specified.     },

      "reason": "No GD&T feature control frames (e.g. □, ○, ⊥ with values) are visible in any tile or full image; only datum labels 'A' and general tolerance notes exist. All 'gdt' symbols listed are actually general tolerance notes, not frames. Per hard rule, only symbols drawn as lines count. Thus S4 and S5 should be reclassified as 'other' or omitted. But they are textual notes in the tolerance table, not drawn symbols. Since the instruction says 'symbols drawn as lines', and these are text, they belong in notes, not symbols. Therefore, symbols array should be empty except for datum symbols S2 and S3, which are visible as letters with leader lines in tiles."
